patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I was just sitting there and suddenly got this sharp pain in the right side of my chest and couldn't catch my breath. It's worse when I breathe in. I'm tall and thin, it came out of nowhere.
clinical.presentationShort: 24yo M, tall/thin — sudden pleuritic chest pain & dyspnea, decreased breath sounds R side — spontaneous pneumothorax.
clinical.presentationLong: 24-year-old tall, thin male with sudden pleuritic right-sided chest pain and dyspnea, with decreased breath sounds on the right — spontaneous pneumothorax.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → CXR (or bedside US), oxygen, needle decompression/chest tube if large or tensioning; monitor for tension.
diagnosis.why: Tall thin young man, sudden pleuritic pain + short of breath = spontaneous pneumothorax. Oxygen; decompress if it tensions.
diagnosis.redFlag: Sudden pleuritic pain + dyspnea + decreased breath sounds = pneumothorax; watch for tension (hypotension, tracheal shift).

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated upright, one hand on the right chest, breathing shallow
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 24-year-old tall, thin man, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright, one hand pressed to the right side of his chest, breathing shallowly. Expression: alarmed and breathless. Clearly visible: a hand on the right chest and guarded, shallow breathing. No text, no logos.
